description: Governor's Office - North Central Province - Vacancy in the posts of Chairman of the Medawachchiya and Dimbulagala Pradeshiya Sabas in North Central Province and Activation of Power and Functions to the Deputy Chairman
categorisation: This gazette content focuses exclusively on personnel changes (resignations and vacancies) of specific named individuals (Herath Hamige Senarathna and Jayantha Marasinghe) in local government positions (Pradeshiya Sabha Chairmen). It does not contain detailed descriptions of portfolio responsibilities or government structural changes, making it a People Gazette (Type 2) rather than a Hybrid or Organisational type. The content involves government personnel matters without specialized category elements.
